Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: Prompt Seen showcase image for case 10
Primary request: Minimal promotional poster with a dark green tea tin as hero, bold deep cobalt background, dramatic single-source light, product in lower two-thirds, clean negative space in upper area for headline, no generated text or claims.
Subject: 留白促销海报
Constraints: make this one distinct image for this case; preserve the requested composition and subject; no readable generated text, no logos, no watermark; do not reuse a stock composition or another case's image.
Avoid: duplicate objects, collage, unrelated props, distorted geometry.

en.title: Promotional poster with copy space
en.description: A green tea tin occupies the lower portion of a cobalt poster, leaving the top clear for later copy.
